screen.stallium.title: Stallium Settings
modmenu.summaryTranslation.stallium: Horse stats, best-horse glow, breeding hints and foal timers.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.stallium: Client-side horse assistant: stat bars for speed, jump height and health above every horse, exact numbers on aim or Shift, a golden glow on the best horse nearby, breeding pair hints based on the vanilla offspring formula, foal growth timers and a riding HUD. Configure with the H key or via ModMenu.
